points.quote: Where I have used AI to research content, find authors, papers, or ideas, I have fully referenced this in APA7 and provided the original text prompts in an appendix.
points.gist: Students who used AI to research content, authors, papers or ideas declare they referenced it in APA7 and gave the prompts in an appendix.

points.quote: I certify that I have not used any Generative Artificial Intelligence tools in the preparation of this work.
points.gist: The alternative declaration is certifying that no Generative AI tools were used in preparing the work.

points.quote: whether they have/have not used Generative Artificial Intelligence tools
points.gist: The assessment cover sheet asks students to declare whether or not they have used Generative AI tools.

points.quote: I certify that I have not used Grammarly or similar to correct my spelling, punctuation, grammar and/or syntax.
points.gist: The cover sheet has a separate declaration that students have not used Grammarly or similar tools to correct spelling, punctuation, grammar or syntax.

points.quote: OpenAI's ChatGPT is the most well-known example, but other systems like Bing Chat, DALL.E, and Google Bard also exist, with new products emerging frequently.
points.gist: Names ChatGPT, Bing Chat, DALL.E and Google Bard as examples of GenAI systems, with new products emerging frequently.

points.quote: Markers should review the Turnitin similarity scores of assessments submitted online as part of the marking process and should provide feedback comments where the similarity score is higher than 20%
points.gist: Markers should review Turnitin similarity scores and give feedback comments where the score is higher than 20%.

points.quote: Further staff guidance on the capabilities and limitations of GenAI, as well as samples of the use and embedding of GenAI into teaching practice, can be found on the staff pages of the University Gateway.
points.gist: Staff guidance on GenAI capabilities and limitations, and examples of embedding it in teaching, is on the staff pages of the University Gateway.

points.quote: Providers establish coherent approaches to technologies that impact teaching, learning and assessment (such as Generative Artificial Intelligence).
points.gist: Quoting the QAA Quality Code, providers establish coherent approaches to technologies such as Generative AI that affect teaching, learning and assessment.
